mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 41 degrees under overcast skies near Verona Community Park, with a waning crescent moon visible. Tonight's low will hit 33 degrees and we are not expecting any rain.

The Plan Commission meets December 7th to discuss new projects, including the Sub-Zero expansion at Liberty Business Park. Meanwhile, the city continues to update engineering reports and reminds everyone to subscribe to the digital newsletter for all municipal news.

There is plenty to do, with yoga happening today and ART House 360 opening its doors today as well. Looking ahead, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, plus live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee both tomorrow.

Regarding the latest police report, on October 25th, officers conducted an O W I arrest after discovering an individual unresponsive in a vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Since Culver's is closed for the evening, today's flavor of the day is done for now. Be sure to stop by tomorrow morning starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor.
